quests.instruction: Scan the sentence to find the day mentioned.
quests.passage: Maria's book club meets every Thursday evening.
quests.hint: Look for the name of a day of the week.
quests.explanation: The sentence names Thursday as the meeting day, not Tuesday.

quests.instruction: Search the sentence for the closing time.
quests.passage: The library closes at six o'clock tonight.
quests.hint: Search for the number that tells the time.
quests.explanation: The library's closing time is six; seven does not appear as a time here.

quests.instruction: Look through the sentence to find the pet's name.
quests.passage: Tom's dog is named Rex.
quests.hint: Look for the word that is a name, not an everyday word.
quests.explanation: The dog's name is Rex; Tom is the owner, not the pet.

quests.instruction: Scan for the street name in the sentence.
quests.passage: The bakery on Elm Street opens at seven every morning.
quests.hint: Search for the name of the street, not the opening time.
quests.explanation: The bakery is on Elm Street; seven tells the opening time, not the place.

quests.instruction: Find the exact date given in the sentence.
quests.passage: Grandpa's birthday is on the twelfth of May.
quests.hint: Find the number that shows the day of the month.
quests.explanation: The birthday falls on the twelfth; May only names the month.

quests.instruction: Search the sentence for the pizza size.
quests.passage: Sara ordered a medium pizza with mushrooms.
quests.hint: Look for the word describing size, not the topping.
quests.explanation: Sara ordered a medium pizza; mushrooms is the topping, not the size.

quests.instruction: Scan to find what time the team eats lunch.
quests.passage: After the meeting ends, the team will go to lunch at noon.
quests.hint: Search for the time word placed near the word lunch.
quests.explanation: Lunch happens at noon; the sentence never gives a time for the meeting itself.

quests.instruction: Look for the platform number in the sentence.
quests.passage: The train to Boston departs from platform four.
quests.hint: Search for the number that identifies the platform.
quests.explanation: The platform number is four; Boston only names the destination city.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the subject Mrs. Alvarez teaches.
quests.passage: Mrs. Alvarez teaches math to the ninth-grade class.
quests.hint: Search for the school subject mentioned in the sentence.
quests.explanation: Mrs. Alvarez teaches math; ninth-grade only describes the class level.

quests.instruction: Search for the adult ticket price.
quests.passage: The concert tickets cost fifteen dollars for adults and eight dollars for children.
quests.hint: Look for the price listed right before the word adults.
quests.explanation: Adult tickets cost fifteen dollars; eight dollars is the price for children.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence to find the bus interval.
quests.passage: The bus to the airport leaves every twenty minutes.
quests.hint: Search for the number describing the gap between buses.
quests.explanation: The bus leaves every twenty minutes; ten is not mentioned as the interval.

quests.instruction: Find the second practice day mentioned.
quests.passage: Emma's soccer practice is on Monday and Wednesday afternoons.
quests.hint: Look for the day that comes after Monday in the sentence.
quests.explanation: Both days are practice days, but Wednesday is the second one named.

quests.instruction: Search for the name of David's brother.
quests.passage: David and his brother Carlos both work at the hospital downtown.
quests.hint: Look for the name that belongs to the brother, not to David.
quests.explanation: David is named first, but Carlos is specifically identified as his brother.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for the house number.
quests.passage: The package was delivered to 42 Baker Street on Friday.
quests.hint: Search for the number that comes right before Baker Street.
quests.explanation: The address number is 42; 24 is a similar-looking number that never appears.

quests.instruction: Look for the time period of the exhibit.
quests.passage: The museum's new exhibit features paintings from the 1800s.
quests.hint: Search for the number that names the century of the paintings.
quests.explanation: The paintings are from the 1800s; the 1900s never appears in the sentence.

quests.instruction: Search for when the connecting flight leaves.
quests.passage: The morning flight lands at ten, but the connecting flight leaves at eleven thirty.
quests.hint: Search for the second time in the sentence, which is about leaving.
quests.explanation: Ten is the landing time; eleven thirty is when the connecting flight departs.

quests.instruction: Scan the recipe line for the sugar amount.
quests.passage: The recipe needs two cups of flour and one cup of sugar.
quests.hint: Look for the number placed right before the word sugar.
quests.explanation: The recipe needs one cup of sugar; two cups refers to the flour instead.

quests.instruction: Find the floor number in the sentence.
quests.passage: The manager's office is on the third floor, next to the break room.
quests.hint: Search for the number that names the floor.
quests.explanation: The office is on the third floor; the break room only shows what's nearby.

quests.instruction: Scan the notice for the closing day.
quests.passage: Notice: The pool will be closed for cleaning on Sunday.
quests.hint: Look for the day of the week written in the notice.
quests.explanation: The notice states the pool closes on Sunday, not Saturday.

quests.instruction: Search the reminder for the required item.
quests.passage: Reminder: Bring your ID card to the exam on Tuesday morning.
quests.hint: Search for the item listed right after the word bring.
quests.explanation: The reminder asks students to bring an ID card, not a pencil.

quests.instruction: Look through the message for the wait time.
quests.passage: Message: Dinner is ready, please come downstairs in five minutes.
quests.hint: Look for the number of minutes mentioned in the message.
quests.explanation: The message says to come down in five minutes, not ten.

quests.instruction: Scan for the workshop's real start time.
quests.passage: The workshop begins at nine fifteen and the doors open at nine.
quests.hint: Search for the more exact time, not when the doors open.
quests.explanation: Doors open at nine, but the workshop itself starts at nine fifteen.

quests.instruction: Find how many guests arrived after lunch.
quests.passage: Two guests arrived early, but four more came right after lunch.
quests.hint: Look for the number connected to arriving after lunch.
quests.explanation: Two guests were early; four more arrived later, after lunch.

quests.instruction: Search for the winter watering frequency.
quests.passage: The garden needs watering twice a day during summer, but only once in winter.
quests.hint: Search for the frequency word placed near the word winter.
quests.explanation: In winter the garden is watered once, compared with twice in summer.

quests.instruction: Scan both sentences for the main office's street.
quests.passage: The clinic opened a new branch last month. The main office remains on Fifth Avenue.
quests.hint: Look in the second sentence for the address.
quests.explanation: The first sentence mentions a new branch, but the second names Fifth Avenue as the main office.

quests.instruction: Look for the name of Julia's friend.
quests.passage: Julia finished her homework before dinner. She then called her friend Wendy for twenty minutes.
quests.hint: Search the second sentence for the name of the friend.
quests.explanation: Julia is the subject of the passage; Wendy is the friend she called.

quests.instruction: Find the Saturday discount percentage.
quests.passage: The store restocks shelves every Monday. On Saturdays, it offers a ten percent discount.
quests.hint: Look in the second sentence for the number linked to discount.
quests.explanation: Restocking happens on Monday, but the ten percent discount applies on Saturdays.

quests.instruction: Scan the sentence for Room B's capacity.
quests.passage: The office has three meeting rooms. Room A seats six people, Room B seats ten, and Room C seats fourteen.
quests.hint: Search for the number that comes right after Room B.
quests.explanation: Room B seats ten people; six and fourteen belong to Rooms A and C instead.

quests.instruction: Search for Seattle's departure time.
quests.passage: Flights depart for Chicago at 8 a.m., for Denver at 11 a.m., and for Seattle at 2 p.m.
quests.hint: Look for the time listed right after the word Seattle.
quests.explanation: The Seattle flight leaves at 2 p.m.; the earlier times belong to Chicago and Denver.

quests.instruction: Find the day set aside for adult patients.
quests.passage: The clinic sees children on Mondays, adults on Wednesdays, and seniors on Fridays.
quests.hint: Search for the day that appears next to the word adults.
quests.explanation: Adults are seen on Wednesdays; Mondays and Fridays are set aside for children and seniors.
